Nothing was swapped. intergalactic/windows/third_party/ffmpeg/bin/ is untouched; the swap is gated on a smoke gate that does not exist yet.' - present tense, and it described a directory that no longer exists and a gate that will never be built. why: The shipped static build came from BtbN release autobuild-2026-06-13-13-31, which BtbN has since pruned. Its release_url and asset_url both 404, and the pinned upstream component versions in the build scripts went with the tag.
This record captures the same information for a release that still exists, so the component versions are held before they can be lost again.
Per docs/DECISIONS.md 'Record A Third-Party Binary's Builder Commit SHA At Staging Time' (2026-08-07): the builder commit SHA below came from the tag object itself, not from a timestamp inference.
